text: The owned header requests a timeout factor of2 in coverage builds and 1 otherwise. Fixed accepted source later requests3 and 2. This changes the requested harness budget, not test selection, read-state assertions or message actions. Do not interpret the factors as seconds or treat the historical slowness report as a measured root cause. The review was also reassociated from messageWindow to this actual changed file. No harness or test ran.
title: Mark-as-read timeout multipliers are separate from test assertions and selection
